$description: Read-only state (library plan wave 2, foundation read-only-context): the roles of a value that can be read, selected and copied but not changed. system/read-only.css draws the controls inside a read-only region (data-plx-readonly, providers/ReadOnly.jsx) from them.

read-only-background.$description: The fill of a read-only field or select: the sunken surface, so it reads as not editable without dimming its value (a read-only Input uses the same surface).

read-only-content.$description: The value of a read-only control: full content contrast (4.5:1), never the disabled color, because people must read and copy it.

read-only-border.$description: The edge of a read-only field: the subtle border, quieter than an editable control's border, which tells it takes no input.
